rules.when: same root error occurs >= 2 times in recent evidence
rules.note: Train the causal skill, not merely the same topic.

rules.when: recognition evidence strong and modeling evidence weak
rules.note: Prefer disguised problems; avoid obvious template drills.

rules.when: algorithm is correct but implementation errors repeat
rules.note: Use implementation-heavy but conceptually standard tasks and targeted boundary drills.
Train complexity analysis and optimization transitions.

rules.when: contest attempts repeatedly skip achievable subtasks
problem solved after meaningful hint/error correction
rules.note: Redo must re-lock old code, hints, and key insight.

rules.when: mastery estimate high but evidence lacks transfer/retention
rules.note: Do not treat one template AC as mastery.
